items.summary: Risk disposition: blocked for public beta or full launch; conditional for bounded reversible work that preserves existing consent, disclosures, provenance, claims, affiliate, copyright/trademark, platform-policy, and data-handling boundaries. Woot documentation establishes API access but not rights to store, derive, display, cache, alert, or monetize data. Human counsel is required before rights-dependent launch or outreach. Exact decision: keep SearchWoot private and preview-only; keep outreach unsent pending counsel review and owner authorization.

Launch-readiness tracking remains active: 0 of 4 tasks closed and 4 open. Existing progress includes official Woot API, terms, support, repository/configuration, privacy, cookie-policy, and draft-terms evidence. No task is closed because rights, field permissions, retention, deletion/correction/access workflows, notification consent, GA4 settings, vendor coverage, incident procedures, accuracy/freshness, and rollback evidence remain incomplete. Next evidence action: attach and review one consolidated read-only bundle covering the field-level rights matrix, deployed data-flow and retention table, log/vendor/incident inventory, consent and GA4 configuration evidence, accuracy/freshness controls, and rollback evidence.
